title: ToolResult
description: Generic wrapper for results returned when an AI agent executes a Fractales tool. Agents should unwrap 'data' and handle 'error' before passing results to the user.

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced this result

success.description: True if the tool call completed without error

data.description: The result payload. Shape depends on the tool. See individual tool definitions in tools.json.

source_url.description: The URL that was fetched to produce this result (for GET-based tools)
